clips.title: Finding the watch by voice, in AR
captions: The labels float over the room. Tap Speak and ask out loud.
You ask: “Hey Recall, where's my watch?”
Recall: it's on the cabinet in the living room, on shelf 1, at waist height, seen 37 minutes ago.
Straight ahead, 1 metre; at 1 o'clock, 90 centimetres…
Your watch should be in front of you. The camera checks it's really there.
Found it: at 12 o'clock, 40 centimetres away.

clips.title: The room through the iPhone, with a label on everything Recall found
